gloss: karma; divine retribution; what goes around comes around

definitions.explanation: The Buddhist concept that good deeds bring good results and bad deeds bring bad results. Used to express the idea that one's actions inevitably have consequences.

examples.english: Through karma, he faced the consequences of his misdeeds.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{因|いん} (cause) + {果|か} (result) + {応|おう} (response) + {報|ほう} (retribution)
"Cause and effect respond with retribution"
From Buddhist teachings about karma, where one's actions (cause) inevitably lead to results (effect), whether in this life or the next.

USAGE:
Used when bad things happen to someone who has done wrong, or to emphasize that good actions will eventually be rewarded. Can be used seriously or somewhat sarcastically.
